newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ciampi promises lira in ERM by year-end - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi promises lira in ERM by year-end - paper.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi is confident that the lira will be inside the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) before the end of the year, Germany's Handelsblatt newspaper said on Friday.
"It is completely certain before the end of the year," he was quoted in the newspaper as saying.

Ciampi also said in an interview with the newspaper that he had no doubts that, by joining the ERM by year-end, Italy would be able to satisfy a Maastricht criterion requiring currencies to trade within the ERM bands for two years.
The interview was published ahead of the European Banking Congress, at which Ciampi is due to speak.
Most analysts have been expecting the lira, which crashed out of the ERM in 1992, to return to the mechanism in time for the European Union's Dublin summit on December 13-14.
